scope: 1000 population, six generations, seeds 731/42/2026 with and without one reincarnator are the bounded original paired trajectories. Seeds are correctness sensitivity checks, not user product batch experiments.
10000 population, six generations, seed 731 is native-only: there is no original measurement and no valid original speedup for that workload.
All C2 experiments force native_min_rows=1 and use thread budgets 1/2/4. Budget and eligible batch count do not prove actual core occupancy.
Timing uses three unobserved fresh-process repeats at seed 731. Initialization and final snapshot are outside trajectory phase timing.

Each job has its own runner/CPU. Cross-job absolute timings are not directly comparable. Frozen A2/off and frozen C1/c1only timing discrepancies expose noise or code-layout effects; use same-revision C1only to isolate C2.

The isolated birth state includes 1000 existing entities. A nonzero whole-state score error versus original is not evidence of newborn score change; integer-zero newborn score and empty caches are checked separately.

Full isolated entry reuses the C2 pool warmed during initial population. Prepacked kernel boundary is a separate fresh evaluator including FFI, output allocation and cold worker-pool startup; it is not pure C++ time or a whole-world speedup.
Observer checks apply to trajectories. Isolated birth calls have contract/digest checks but are not observed/plain trajectory pairs.
Reported error maxima are final sampled-state maxima across completed cases, not a proof of exact equality for all seeds or long runs. First-fork locations have checkpoint resolution.
